title: Kontoor Brands Declares Quarterly Dividend, a 2 Percent Increase

# Kontoor Brands Declares Quarterly Dividend, a 2 Percent Increase


[Download as PDF](https://www.kontoorbrands.com/_assets/_78fade6165d598885c95258bbd531d10/kontoorbrands/news/2026-10-22_Kontoor_Brands_Declares_Quarterly_Dividend_a_2_245.pdf) October 22, 2026 6:50am EDT


GREENSBORO, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.54 per share of its common stock, an increase of $0.01 or 2 percent. The cash dividend will be payable on December 18, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business December 8, 2026.


***About Kontoor Brands***


Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) is a portfolio of three of the world’s most iconic lifestyle, outdoor and workwear brands: *Wrangler* ®, *Lee* ® and *Helly Hansen* ®. Kontoor Brands is a purpose-led organization focused on leveraging its global platform, strategic sourcing model and best-in-class supply chain to drive brand growth and deliver long-term value for its stakeholders. For more information about Kontoor Brands, please visit[www.KontoorBrands.com](http://www.kontoorbrands.com/) .
